description: Get the FAA Command Center's current operations plan: terminal programs (possible ground stops and delay programs by airport) and en-route initiatives (route closures, severe-weather avoidance plans) expected later in the day, each with its planned UTC time and stated likelihood, plus current ATCSCC announcements. The advisory reference opens the full plan text with faa_delays_get_advisory, including active constraints and runway closures this summary omits.
name: faa_delays_get_operations_plan

advisory.description: Reference to the ATCSCC advisory behind this item, absent when the FAA feed links none. For the full text, call faa_delays_get_advisory with number as advisory_number and date as date.

number.description: ATCSCC advisory number; numbers restart at 1 each UTC day.

url.description: Server-built advisory URL, the page faa_delays_get_advisory reads for this number and date.

announcements.description: Current ATCSCC announcements; [] when there are none, absent when that FAA list could not be read.

enRoutePlanned.description: En-route initiatives the FAA expects later today: route closures, severe-weather avoidance plans (SWAP), and coded departure routes (CDRs), in plan order.

likelihood.description: The FAA's stated likelihood: possible (<30 %), probable (30–60 %), or expected (most likely). Absent when the text states none.

text.description: The planned item as the FAA wrote it, tabs flattened and the leading dash removed (FAA-authored).

timeQualifier.description: How the planned time bounds the item, parsed from the start of the text; for between, timeUtc is the start of the window and its end stays in text.

timeUtc.description: Planned time as HHMM UTC, with no date. Its day comes from the plan's event window (the EVENT TIME line of the plan advisory, read with faa_delays_get_advisory), which can start on the UTC day after the advisory date.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: NAS Status unreachable, 5xx, an attempt timeout, or an HTML maintenance page, after retries. `upstream_rate_limited`: The FAA returned 429 after retries, or this server's queue to the FAA would wait past 10 s while backing off from an FAA 429. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The 20 s retry budget ran out. `pacer_shed`: This server's own queue to the FAA would wait past 10 s with no FAA 429 backoff in effect. `feed_contract_changed`: The feed path returned 404/410, or a body whose shape this server no longer recognizes. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fetchedAt.description: When this server fetched the operations plan from the FAA (UTC ISO); with the 60 s cache it can trail the call by up to a minute.

notice.description: Guidance on an empty plan, a missing advisory link, or partial data.

terminalPlanned.description: Terminal programs the FAA expects later today: possible ground stops and delay programs by airport, in plan order.

likelihood.description: The FAA's stated likelihood: possible (<30 %), probable (30–60 %), or expected (most likely). Absent when the text states none.

text.description: The planned item as the FAA wrote it, tabs flattened and the leading dash removed (FAA-authored).

timeQualifier.description: How the planned time bounds the item, parsed from the start of the text; for between, timeUtc is the start of the window and its end stays in text.

timeUtc.description: Planned time as HHMM UTC, with no date. Its day comes from the plan's event window (the EVENT TIME line of the plan advisory, read with faa_delays_get_advisory), which can start on the UTC day after the advisory date.

title: Get FAA Operations Plan
